text: Jab dil mein sachha vishwas ho, toh mushkil se mushkil raasta bhi aasan lagne lagta hai. Choti choti baaton mein khushi dhoondna hi asli sukoon hai.
Aapki mehanat aur niyat hamesha rang laati hai. Kuch dooriyan bas aapko aage badhne ka raasta dikhane aati hain.
ମନର ଶାନ୍ତି ହିଁ ଜୀବନର ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ନୂଆ ସକାଳ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ନୂଆ ଆଶା ନେଇ ଆସିଥାଏ।
Quiet moments of faith have the power to heal what words cannot express. Trust the timing of your life.
Maan mein shanti ho toh har din ek utsav jaisa lagta hai. Khud par bharosa rakhiye, aap har kathinai ko paar kar sakti hain.
Waqt hamesha sikhata hai ki sabse gehri roshni andhere ke baad hi chamakti hai. Aapka aane wala pal sundar hoga.
ହୃଦୟରେ ଦୟା ଓ ସ୍ନେହ ରଖି ଚାଲନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କ କୃପାରୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ମାର୍ଗ ସୁଗମ ହୋଇଯିବ।
Jagannath Mahaprabhu ki kripa har us shanti mein hai jo aap achanak dil mein mehsoos karti hain. Har din ek nayi shuruaat hai.
Bhakti aur courage jab ek saath milte hain, toh koi bhi drishti asambhav nahi rehti. Hanuman ji ki kripa aapke saath hai.
Softness is not weakness; it is the quiet strength that moves mountains with grace.
